planck.js 1.5.1 (https://github.com/piqnt/planck.js), MIT. Unmodified copies of dist/planck.mjs and dist/planck.d.ts from the npm tarball planck-1.5.1.tgz, plus its LICENSE.txt.

`SHA256` lists the SHA-256 of all three files. Verify with `shasum -a 256 -c vendor/planck/SHA256` from the repo root. All three were re-checked byte for byte against a fresh `npm pack planck@1.5.1` on 2026-10-21 (tarball SHA-256 399a158e2ef778d03255da3414d8e899a771c7d4c55d7e5366c54af142dedd42).
